Hi Lisa and team,

Thanks again for agreeing to run the hands-on POC workshop with Redwood next week. To make the working session productive, I pulled together a short preflight checklist and two proposed workshop slots. Can you confirm which works for you and share the items below before we start?

Proposed slots (Pacific):
- Tue Oct 6, 10:00–12:30 PT (preferred: prompt review + routing walkthrough + small load test)
- Thu Oct 8, 09:00–11:30 PT (if Tue conflicts)

Preflight checklist (attached: preflight_checklist.pdf):
- API key for staging/sandbox (token limited to test data) or a service-account credential
- VPC/firewall allowlist CIDRs for Redwood staging egress IPs
- Sandbox account (or staging URL) with a test prompt set + sample data
- Confirmation of who from your network team will be on the call for routing/egress questions
- Any internal rate-limit constraints or load-test windows

Agenda we plan to cover (2.5 hrs):
1) Quick intro & goals (10m)
2) Prompt review & guardrails (25m)
3) Routing & prefixging walkthrough (30m)
4) Live staging integration (30m)
5) Controlled load test and metrics capture (30m)
6) Next steps & action items (15m)

Can you reply with the slot you prefer and the staging API key delivery method? If firewall changes are needed, please include the network contact and any required tickets so we can coordinate prework.

CCing Rachel (CS lead) and Stephanie (solutions) so they can prepare the prompt set and test harness.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
